To tailor “suitable” AI PhD directions, programs, funding, and the 1–2 year plan, please provide:
- Your current/expected degree, field, university tier or country, GPA/class rank, and expected graduation date
- AI research interests (e.g., machine learning, NLP, computer vision, robotics, trustworthy AI) and relevant research, publications, internships, or projects
- Citizenship/residency, languages and test status (TOEFL/IELTS/GRE), plus any geographic preferences or restrictions
- Funding requirement and approximate annual budget if unfunded
- Intended application cycle or desired PhD start date

- Current undergraduate in Computer Science and Technology at a prestigious university in Jiangsu, China. Academic performance is excellent, with university scholarships for two consecutive years; exact GPA, class rank, and graduation date are not specified.
- Interested in applied, implementation-heavy AI and algorithm research, especially deep learning and NLP. Specific research experience, publications, internships, and projects are not specified.
- Citizenship, languages, and TOEFL/IELTS/GRE status are not specified. Residence is Suzhou, Jiangsu. I prefer access to strong technology ecosystems and intellectually active cities; no geographic restrictions are specified.
- Strong funding or scholarships and cost-effectiveness are important. An annual unfunded budget is not specified.
- Intended application cycle and desired PhD start date are not specified.
